method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation from legislation.wa.gov.au (mrdoc 47549, retrieved 2026-09-07), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_47549.txt; compilation table to the Vocational Education and Training Amendment Act 2024 (No. 8 of 2024; s 6 in force 11 Jul 2024); last reprint listed Reprint 2 as at 7 Aug 2009; no compilation number stated. No regulations deposited: the Vocational Education and Training (General) Regulations 2009 are not read, and what they provide is an input.

scope: From the seat of the apprentice or trainee (and the school leaver going to TAFE): s 5 (approved VET course) and s 58A(1)-(3) (who may provide a course or confer a qualification, $10,000); s 60A (apprentice, training contract); s 60B (Part 7 prevails over awards); s 60C(3)-(4) (class A, B, C qualifications) and s 60D (offences, $10,000); s 60E (what a training contract is, more than one employer, who signs, with s 60(b)-(c); variation, suspension, assignment); s 60F (registration and commencement, lodging $3,000, refusal and cancellation, appeal to the WAIRC); s 60G (probation and termination, chief executive's approval, $10,000, appeal); s 60H (employment ends with the contract); s 60I (assessed competent instead); s 60(f), (i) (disputes and qualification appeals left to regulations, asked as facts).
seat: the apprentice or trainee (and the school leaver going to TAFE)
